t: You're standing near Tortoises with Triangle and Time, an outdoor bronze sculpture in Holland Park, beside Abbotsbury Road. It shows two tortoises and a large triangle that works as a sundial. Wendy Taylor made it in 2000 to celebrate the Millennium. Taylor is an English sculptor who specialises in permanent, site-specific commissions, and she was among the first artists of her generation to take art out of the galleries and onto the streets. Her large works often look carefully balanced, so see how the triangle and the tortoises sit together.
